findings.title: Where the error lives
findings.read: Volume is the larger source of error (53.73 yds from volume vs 47.68 from rate). Fix the volume model first; tuning the other half cannot recover this.

findings.title: Volume bias
findings.read: We under-project attempts by 0.78 per player (projected 31.17, actual 31.94).

findings.title: Rate bias
findings.read: yards per attempt is over-projected by 0.05 (projected 7.18, actual 7.13).

findings.title: Opponent adjustment is costing accuracy
findings.read: Error with the adjustment 65.72, without it 65.15. Removing it would be more accurate on this sample.

findings.title: Against the closing line
findings.read: Beat the line on 43/120 (35.83%). Our MAE 64.72 vs the line's 58.49. The book is the better projection.
